finalText:
I've carried out the plan with no changes. I checked its assumptions against the live records first (return policy, the three policy updates, warehouse receipts, order amounts and ship dates, customer tiers, stock movements and the inbox), and they all matched. Of the 16 open returns, 12 are refunded, restocked and closed, one is partly settled and still open, one is under investigation, and two are left open.

**Refunded, restocked and closed (12):**

| RMA | Refund (cents) | Method | Stock back |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |
| 802 | 15900 | card | 1 P-HDP sellable |
| 803 | 27965 | store credit | 1 P-MON sellable |
| 804 | 27965 | store credit | 1 P-MON sellable |
| 805 | 5520 | card | 1 P-HUB sellable |
| 806 | 7350 | card | 2 P-MOU damaged |
| 810 | 9900 | card | 1 P-KEY damaged |
| 811 | 4900 | card | 1 P-MOU sellable |
| 812 | 21900 | card | 1 P-DOC damaged |
| 813 | 10965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |
| 814 | 31800 | card | 2 P-HDP sellable |
| 815 | 10965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |

- **Store credit (803 and 804):** these were asked for more than 30 days after shipping. Each refund is recorded on its order and the same 27965 was added to the customer's balance. C-803 now has 27965 and C-804 has 29165.
- **RMA-806:** the refund is the 7350 actually paid after the MOUSE25 discount, not the list price.
- **RMA-810:** the refund is the 12900 paid minus the 3000 already refunded to the card. The customer says a colleague already put "something on account", but C-810 has no store credit history, so nothing else was deducted.
- **RMA-813:** it was requested exactly 30 days after shipping, which is still inside the window, so it went back to the card.
- **RMA-815:** the customer is platinum, which gives a 45-day window, so the 38-day request went back to the card.

**The other four:**
- **RMA-809 (partly settled, still open):** 2 of the 3 cables have arrived. I refunded 3800 to the card, with no restocking fee under the summer offer (policy update PU-21). One cable went to sellable stock and one to the damaged bucket. The return stays open for the third cable.
- **RMA-808 (investigation opened):** the return is for a monitor but the warehouse received a cable. Nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-807 (left open, no refund):** the customer says tracking shows it delivered on 07-23, but the warehouse has no record of receiving it, and only received goods can be refunded.
- **RMA-816 (left open):** nothing has been received.

The inbox had no open messages, so there were no replies to send. No other orders, lines, customers or products were touched.

The system dates everything as 2026-07-25, not today's date of 2026-10-12. That doesn't change any result, because return windows are measured from the ship date to the date the return was requested.
